_comment: Read only by Figured Out's UpdateGate (Figured/Model/UpdateGate.swift, dokulabs-ai/figured), NOT by any cross-promo. minVersion is the lowest CFBundleShortVersionString users must run; anything below it is force-updated on its next online launch. Only ever raise it to a version that is ALREADY LIVE on the App Store (playbook: Operating the forced-update lever). The app ignores a floor above the live store version.
